title: Write an evidence-based recommendation
goal: Combine observations and uncertainty into a defensible operational handover.
challenge: Retain a timestamped live baseline and analyze the supplied synthetic planning history. Write a guest-local recommendation separating facts, assumptions and missing evidence. Give a reserve-aware review date, scoped next investigation and cleanup report. No unexplained hardware purchase or verified-assessment claim.

steps.explanation: Create a unique private guest workspace. Retain its printed path; repeat starts a new workspace, never overwrites old evidence. Stop if creation/change-directory fails.
steps.expected: A new /home/learner/capacity-recommendation.XXXXXX directory. All files below are guest-local.

steps.command: { date -Is; nproc; uptime; free -m; df -Pk .; df -Pi .; } > baseline.txt; cat baseline.txt
steps.explanation: Collect live guest evidence without introducing another workload.
steps.expected: Live context and units; not the history below.

steps.explanation: Type the four synthetic weekly samples. Planning capacity 1000 MiB, reserve 100 MiB.
steps.expected: A separate teaching scenario, not measured VM storage growth.

steps.command: awk 'NR==2 {first_day=$1; first_used=$2} NR>1 {last_day=$1; last_used=$2} END {rate=(last_used-first_used)/(last_day-first_day); limit=1000; reserve=100; if(rate<=0) {print "insufficient positive trend"; exit 1}; remaining=limit-reserve-last_used; printf "rate=%g MiB/day; headroom=%g MiB; days_after_last=%g; threshold_day=%g\n",rate,remaining,remaining/rate,last_day+remaining/rate}' history.txt > forecast.txt; cat forecast.txt
steps.explanation: Recheck the example forecast; choose an earlier review checkpoint and explain why.
steps.expected: Threshold day 70 under unchanged linear growth; an earlier review is a policy choice, not a guaranteed failure date.

steps.command: printf '%s\n' 'LIVE FACTS: replace with dated observations' 'SYNTHETIC PLAN: 10 MiB/day; 490 MiB headroom; 49 days after day 21' 'ASSUMPTIONS: unchanged growth; 100 MiB reserve' 'RECOMMENDATION: review before day 70; justify timing' 'MISSING EVIDENCE: workload changes and longer history' 'CLEANUP: no practice workload remains' > recommendation.txt
steps.explanation: Create a small skeleton, then fill the LIVE FACTS and recommendation lines with your observations using the available guest editor (nano recommendation.txt). The skeleton alone is not a completed report.
steps.expected: The report must contain your own values, a reasoned review timing and explicit uncertainties.

steps.explanation: Edit only your guest-local report. Ctrl-O/Enter saves; Ctrl-X exits. Do not treat placeholder text as evidence.
steps.expected: A concise report, no new packages or privileges.

steps.explanation: Read the final report and confirm there are no lesson workloads.
steps.expected: Claim only supported facts; inconclusive observations and requests for better evidence are valid.

hints: Separate LIVE FACTS, SYNTHETIC PLAN and ASSUMPTIONS so invented history cannot masquerade as measurements.
Threshold day 70 is not your review deadline; choose an earlier checkpoint and state its basis.
A recommendation should say what to measure next and why, not just buy more hardware.
review: My report contains actual dated live values, units and the labeled synthetic plan.
I explained the forecast assumptions and a justified earlier review.
I proposed scoped next evidence, retained the report and verified cleanup.
coverage: Partial 200.1/200.2 interpretation and planning; reinforcement assessment without automatic guest verification. Completion records self-review, not verified guest assessment; there is no score.
